mechanism: Semaglutide delays gastric emptying and may reduce mefloquine absorption; mefloquine's neuropsychiatric effects combined with GLP-1 receptor agonist side effects (nausea) may increase GI and CNS adverse events.
action: Monitor for reduced antimalarial efficacy and increased GI/neuropsychiatric side effects; consider alternative antimalarial if possible or separate dosing timing by 2+ hours.
